applicabilityBasis.summary: apxUSD is marketed as a synthetic dollar and used as a collateral and quote asset, with USDC settlement on primary-market redemption. Current documentation says its Redemption Value tracks preferred-equity collateral and cash rather than guaranteeing a fixed dollar amount, and the Terms describe protocol-generated claims against modules rather than a named legal issuer. GENIUS section 2(22) requires payment/settlement design and an issuer obligation to redeem for fixed monetary value. Whether apxUSD holder rights meet that obligation remains unresolved. Preferred-share collateral, foreign domicile and U.S. access restrictions are not themselves statutory exclusions, and holding preferred shares in reserves does not make apxUSD an excluded security.

genius.notes: Current terms name Preference Capital (BVI) Ltd. and affiliates as the Site/protocol operator, but expressly deny that apxUSD/apyUSD is a claim against a particular legal person. The former issuerEntity "Preference Capital (BVI) Ltd. / Apyx" and issuerDomicile have therefore been omitted: the named BVI operator is not substantiated as the token obligor. The monthly accountant report instead identifies Preference Foundation or its subsidiaries as securities owners; neither reserve ownership nor the Apyx brand establishes a legal token issuer. A primary-market redemption policy exists and pays USDC at variable Redemption Value; redemptionPolicyPresent remains false because this tracker field concerns public 1:1/par redemption, not merely any redemption mechanism. MonthlyAttestationPresent remains true for published monthly accountant examinations of Preference Foundation securities holdings, not complete apxUSD reserve-to-liability reconciliation or GENIUS-compliant monthly certification. The August report covers assets at August 13/31 and was signed September 11; cash sleeves, token liabilities and the full protocol reserve reconciliation are not covered. The Terms restrict U.S., EU, UK and Canadian persons; these territorial restrictions do not establish an exclusion, authorization or foreign exception. No token-specific public GENIUS approval, state qualification, filed application, foreign registration or enforcement action was found in the bounded opened-source review. September SCRC procedures are not Act effectiveness or issuer qualification. The Act remains pre-effective in the reviewed landscape, and the broad DASP restriction has the separate July 18, 2028 statutory start date.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No opened regulator record or exact-name official-domain search established Apyx/apxUSD, Preference Capital (BVI) Ltd. or Preference Foundation GENIUS permitted-issuer approval, state qualification, filed token-specific application, or registered foreign-issuer exception. Current issuer/operator materials disclose no token-specific GENIUS pathway. The OCC digital-assets bank application table and NYDFS directory are bounded public sources, not exhaustive GENIUS registers. No public token-specific enforcement action was found. This negative observation neither proves legal non-compliance nor resolves the unidentified token obligor.
